hints.title: Two End Choices
hints.text: At each index i, you choose either nums1[i] or nums2[i].

hints.title: Tracking Lengths
hints.text: Keep two variables tracking the longest valid subarray ending at nums1[i] and nums2[i].

hints.title: Transition Rules
hints.text: Compare the current choice against both possible values at index i - 1 and take the best extended length.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of the input arrays
complexity.notes: Maintains the two best running subarray lengths ending at nums1[i] and nums2[i].
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 2^n binary decisions produces combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time with O(1) space by storing only the previous step variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the state depends only on which array element was chosen at step i - 1.
